analysis:
Documentation-only batch.

protocol-messages.md: the changed head lines are 3, 171-195 (the new add-on hold busy-field section), 284, 383 and 1445. The supplied units 10-11 cover head 948-1573, where the only changed line is 1445: `addon_hold` added to the ModelAutopilotBusyReason vocabulary. That is a closed-vocabulary, additive diagnostic. It grants no routing or trust, and it aligns with the new add-on hold.

The busy-field section at head 171-195 is not in the supplied units; it is seen only through the patch excerpt. Per that excerpt, a hold reports status `draining` plus optional `busy_reason`, `busy_since_ms` and `busy_addon` fields. The provider never sends `provider_drain`, and coordinator support is separate platform work.

threat-model.yaml adds:
- A-018 (provider_serving_availability).
- TB-012 (add-on hold AF_UNIX socket). Its stated controls are: 0600 socket in a 0700 directory; LOCAL_PEERTOKEN audit token; same-EUID check; Developer ID requirement for team SLDQ2GJ6TL with hardened runtime; identifier match; a DEBUG-only extra identity; 30-600s leases with an ownership.lock fallback; persisted holds; a 120s finish of accepted work before unload. It does not stop the App Attest worker.
- T-059 (DoS).

These are self-consistent with the existing assumptions in TB-003 (operator vs process) and ADV-001. The same-UID limitations are explicitly accepted. A hold only reduces availability (A-018) and does not touch A-001, A-003, A-016 or attestation. Hold persistence keeps a restart held, which fails safe for memory, not open.

No security regression is identifiable from the docs. The provider Swift sources (AddonPeerPolicy.swift, AddonIPCServer.swift, ProviderLoop+AddonHold.swift, ProviderDrain.swift) were not supplied. The claimed signature, peer-token and lease enforcement therefore remains unverified.

Questions for integration:
- Does the hold path truly keep admission fenced against update, reconnect, desired_models and model_autopilot loads?
- Does a `draining` heartbeat while held interact with the models_replace readiness fence? Per head 982-986, draining status cannot release the fence.
- Is the DEBUG identity excluded from release builds?
- Are the busy fields in `register` (raw-attestation encoder) excluded from any attested or hashed transcript?
